purpose: Teach: 同性愛/囚人/開戦/捕虜/硬化/反逆/窮地/救援

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、同性愛者へのヘイト事案を、警察、毅然と対応されますね
lines.en: This case — the hate incident targeting gay people — the police are responding to it firmly, aren't they?
lines.style: Earnest, slightly over-precise opening; careful pause before the sensitive term, gentle rising confirmation at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、囚人護送中の安全確保を、警察、徹底されますね
lines.en: We are. And we're just as thorough about keeping prisoners safe during transport.
lines.style: Measured official cadence, even pitch; each word placed deliberately, quietly reassuring without warmth overreach.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、開戦時の戒厳令下の警察活動の歴史を、警察、振り返られますね
lines.en: And the police look back at the history of policing under martial law, when war broke out, don't they?
lines.style: Animated bookish energy on the historical detail, speeding up mid-line, then a polite checking lift.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、過去の捕虜虐待事案も学ばれますね
lines.en: We do. We also study past cases of prisoner-of-war abuse.
lines.style: Slower, weightier delivery; a small sober pause before the difficult subject, voice kept level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、現場の硬化したコンクリート片を、警察、鑑識されますね
lines.en: For this case, forensics will examine the hardened concrete fragments from the scene, right?
lines.style: Precise, careful enunciation of the technical detail; leaning in slightly, genuinely fascinated by procedure.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、反逆罪に該当する事案も慎重に判断されますね
lines.en: Yes — and cases that could amount to treason are judged with the utmost care.
lines.style: Firm, unhurried gravity; a deliberate beat before 'treason', finishing steady and closed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、窮地に陥った被害者の救護を、警察、迅速にされますね
lines.en: And when a victim is in dire straits, the police get help to them fast, don't they?
lines.style: Warmer, quicker delivery; earnest admiration breaking through the formal phrasing, soft rise at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、災害時の救援チームと連携されますね
lines.en: Always. In a disaster, we coordinate with the relief teams as well.
lines.style: Settled, quietly proud close; unhurried pace, a faint warmth loosening the official tone at last.
